measures.questionText:
Prohibiting Force-Feeding of Birds
Act of 2026.
If enacted, this Initiative would:
(a) Prohibit any person from
force-feeding a bird for the purpose
of enlarging the bird’s liver beyond
normal size;
(b) Ban the sale or distribution of any
product resulting from force-feeding
a bird, including foie gras;
(c) Define force-feeding as inserting a
tube into the bird’s throat to deliver
excessive feed;
(d) Provide for enforcement by the
Department of Energy and
Environment during routine food
safety inspections; and
(e) Provide for civil penalties.

coverageNotes: The Board's General Election Candidates in Ballot Order list supplies the complete printed candidate list. Its separate write-in list supplies registered write-in candidates for the same offices. Advisory Neighborhood Commission contests are outside this federal, District and ward-office package.

All five general-election ward sample-ballot groups (Wards 1, 3, 5, 6 and 2/4/7/8) print Initiative Measure No. 86 and no other District-wide measure. The question is extracted from those official sample ballots; the linked Board formulations document contains the legislative text.
